videos.title: Media Engine: Your Local Video Studio
videos.description: Learn how Media Engine gives creators total local control over their entire video production process. AI-generated presenter and visuals.
videos.transcript:
Media Engine is a fully local video production framework that runs on a single Windows PC, needing no cloud AI service at runtime.

A topic moves through a pipeline that includes discovery, scoring, a duplicate check, and research before any script is written.

The system builds vertical videos, using one permanent presenter alternating with supporting graphics, plus captions and background music.

A research claim only counts as verified when its supporting quote appears word for word in a stored source.
videos.how: Topic -> research from a fact sheet -> seven-worker script -> designed voice + AI presenter -> animated graphics -> independent QA review.
